tools.name: get_help
tools.description: Free, no API key. Usage + full component catalog as TSV (id, name, version, description, provides, requires, conflictsWith). Call this first. Prefer resource botkelp://catalog if your client supports it.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Returns the exact, unrendered source files for one catalog component — the same files a purchased scaffold would include for it. tools.name: purchase_scaffold
tools.description: Requests a build for the given component ids, backed by a private GitHub repo BotKelp owns and manages itself under its own org — never your account. tools.name: get_scaffold
tools.description: Re-fetches a scaffold you already purchased via purchase_scaffold: a fresh clone credential and the current component versions, at no additional credit cost. Identify the project with project_api_key (projectid is optional extra confirmation). For a credit-flow project, this always requires an activ

tools.name: get_projects
tools.description: Lists this account's saved scaffold projects (id, name, description, repo, components, maintain state).

tools.name: set_projects
tools.description: Turns Maintain on/off for one of this account's projects and/or rotates its project_api_key. Identify the project with projectid or project_api_key (at least one is required). Turning maintain off does not delete or revoke anything already cloned; it stops future repeat get_scaffold access after the

tools.name: get_siteprofile
tools.description: Returns one or all of this account's named site profiles (privacy, terms, cookies, licence, custom_field) as JSON bodies + destination paths — not as files in a template repo. Pass list: true to see profile names, or siteprofilename to fetch one. field filters to specific categories (default: all).

tools.name: set_siteprofile
tools.description: Creates or updates one named site profile for this account. Fields omitted from `field` keep their current saved value (or blank, if the profile is new); pass only what changed. custom_field entries are merged key-by-key. An account may keep more than one named profile (e.g. one per brand/site).

tools.name: get_adminpageset
tools.description: Lists this account's admin page set names (omit name), or returns one set's exact files (pass name). These are the file trees purchase_scaffold's admin_page_set param bakes into a dedicated forked repo. Requires account_api_key.

tools.name: set_adminpageset
tools.description: Creates or fully replaces one named admin page set for this account — real file source (React/Next.js), not text config. purchase_scaffold's admin_page_set param bakes a chosen set into a brand-new, dedicated repo. An account may keep more than one named set.

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: File a GitHub issue on https://github.com/botkelp/components/issues about generated or catalog code, or request a new component/docs change.
